why_this_control: sascorer._score2 penalises log10(nChiralCentres+1) where nChiralCentres = Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(includeUnassigned=True), i.e. POTENTIAL centres, not recorded ones. The obvious control (Chem.RemoveStereochemistry on the real corpus) is VACUOUS: that function only clears stereo ANNOTATIONS, so a stereo-stripped copy has identical counts. Verified by running it. This file therefore reports assigned vs unassigned separately, which CAN discriminate.

corrections_2026_10_12.what_was_wrong: TWO DENOMINATORS, ONE PASS. The prefix is not a random sample of the corpus.
